# NO_COLOR means "no color" for any non-empty value (no-color.org), so values
# like `yes` must not fail flag parsing, which would also block the hooks.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin

env NO_COLOR=yes
exec sesam ls
stdout 'README.md'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'commit with NO_COLOR=yes'
